parsed.rationale: Both `AudioPlayerProtocol` and `PlaybackController` live in the same package (`Playback`) and the same directory (`Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Protocols/`), and they share five members verbatim: `installRenderTap:()`, `isPlaying:Bool`, `makeAudioBufferStream:() -> AsyncStream<AVAudioPCMBuffer>`, `removeRenderTap:()`, and `stop:()`. `AudioPlayerProtocol` represents the lower-level audio engine contract (raw `play:()`, `stop:()`, buffer streaming, tap management), while `PlaybackController` is a higher-level orchestration protocol that adds `isLoading`, `state:PlaybackState`, `toggle`, and a richer `play:(reason:)` signature. Making `PlaybackController` inherit from `AudioPlayerProtocol` removes the five duplicated declarations, enforces the layering already implied by the naming, and lets any `PlaybackController` conformer be passed wherever an `AudioPlayerProtocol` is expected. No restraint markers are present on either record.
